script_text: Your ruling planet Venus shakes every Earth-rooted value this week — finances and love arrive at the same table. Friday's Moon opposition to Jupiter creates the pivotal moment where old money patterns crack open. The Sun enters your sixth house of daily work while Pluto squares Mars in your tenth house of career authority — hardworking people see sudden breakthroughs, deadlines shift upward, leadership qualities emerge unexpectedly. Saturday Mercury sextiles Jupiter bringing excellent project news; Sunday honors what you accomplished quietly. Best Day Friday; Worst Day Wednesday. Revisit every financial promise before the week closes. Follow for daily updates.
